question_text: Explain how a properly configured remote-access VPN lets a researcher use private laboratory services securely from home.
adaptation_rationale: VPN function and network countermeasure explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Researcher authenticates; VPN client and lab gateway form a tunnel. Traffic in that tunnel is encrypted against interception. Authorized traffic is routed to private laboratory resources as if connected locally, subject to access rules.

marking_points.criterion: Tunnel between client and organization gateway.
Routes authorized access to private resources.
